title: RCP Registry — StepPrimitive
description: A governed, versioned step primitive (SPEC-008 lineage): a new capability is a NEW id, never a repurposed one; params only ever grow optionally within a version.

v.description: Primitive version referenced by steps as {id, v}.

param_spec.description: JSON Schema fragment validating step.params for this primitive (core delegates: 'validated by the primitive's ParamSpec in the registry, not by core'). Empty object = no params.

technique.description: Optional semantic tag (research 06): fallback anchor when substitutions remove the id-anchored step.
